重要修正：上一版人物在格子边缘被切断，拒收。所有人物和道具必须完整位于每格X80到432，左右至少80像素纯品红留白；人物中心X256不能偏左。头骨宽210、身体高340，头顶Y85脚底Y425，镜头略退但每帧一致。杯底固定Y325，杯中心X320。壶口在杯子上方，细液流真实进入杯口，不能倾壶后没有液流。格线必须留白不能有主体伸出。

PRODUCTION CONSISTENCY CONTRACT (applies to every asset): Declare exact output canvas dimensions, equal cell dimensions when using a sprite grid, intended in-scene footprint, fixed projection/camera, light direction, pixel-cluster density and outline weight matching the scene reference. Backgrounds fill all edges; UI nine-slice corners remain fixed; no baked-in labels or text. Inspect transition between idle and interaction, NOT just individual sheets. Size/anchor/style mismatch means reject and regenerate; a successful HTTP response is not visual approval. For visitors entering or leaving a scene, create an explicit approach/peek/emerge/settle sequence and a physically occluded exit. Start and end the complete loop in the SAME hidden state.
